items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: badges and the history of my grandmother's brother, Sam Taylor -- a well known policeman and sheriff in Portland, Maine

ctx.x: We had a mutual agreement to stick to bourbon and I to vodka at this time, which was another one of our close interests. He had a tremendous love for Ben Webster, and he had a record collection that was unbelievable of all the greats down through the years. He was a big collector, and when he put this party together, those of us who were still living and so forth, he hired us, and I'm happy to say I was one of his favorite drummers, and when he found out how much I knew Ben Webster -- he didn't realize that. One…

And of course, Flip Phillips was another of his loves, which I have mentioned. And he knew my love for guns and my interest in hunting, and also on becoming a sheriff -- my father was up to high sheriff in Cumberland County, Portland, Maine when he died -- he died just before attaining the office of high sheriff. I have his badges and also badges and the history of my grandmother's brother, Sam Taylor -- a well known policeman and sheriff in Portland, Maine in the late 1890's and early 1900's. I was always…
